benchmark_integrity_incidents: Initial pip installation used its default runtime temporary directory because TMPDIR had not yet been redirected. No other candidate or evaluator material was accessed. Subsequent runtime temporary/cache paths are confined to this output directory.
timing_note: Original timestamp preserved; includes time awaiting output-directory clarification.

self_identified_weaknesses.issue: Bond prices expressed per unit face despite PRICE_POINTS labels dominated the least-squares baseline.
self_identified_weaknesses.correction: Added conservative 100x/0.01x scale checks requiring nearby bond and rate evidence; every inference audited.

self_identified_weaknesses.issue: The first cash-flow implementation omitted terminal stub interest, creating systematic bond-pricing bias.
self_identified_weaknesses.correction: Use ACT/365F prorated terminal coupons; evaluate no-stub and full-stub alternatives as model risks.

self_identified_weaknesses.issue: 30 IRLS iterations were insufficient for one alternative stub treatment.
self_identified_weaknesses.correction: Increase cap to 100 and fail explicitly if convergence is not attained.

self_identified_weaknesses.issue: Repeated MAD updates in IRLS prevented convergence on a grouped cross-validation fold even at 100 iterations.
self_identified_weaknesses.correction: Fix robust scale to documented quote uncertainty; damp weight updates, preserving a fixed objective.

self_identified_weaknesses.issue: Fixed-scale IRLS still converged too slowly at Huber transition points in sparse maturity folds.
self_identified_weaknesses.correction: Retain eight IRLS warm-start solves and finish with an exact mixed-loss optimization: Huber data residuals and strictly quadratic curvature penalty; explicitly check optimizer success and bounds.

self_identified_weaknesses.issue: Comparing ordinary least-squares Nelson-Siegel against a robust spline confounded outlier treatment with curve flexibility.
self_identified_weaknesses.correction: Use the same Huber, spread and liquidity objective for both primary models; preserve ordinary least squares as a separately reported ablation. Keep the original 5% holdout Huber improvement hurdle.

self_identified_weaknesses.issue: Malformed numeric strings could be lost during coercion, and a high fraction of downweighted observations could be mistaken for confirmed data errors.
self_identified_weaknesses.correction: Preserve malformed source values in audit reasons; add regression test and prominently disclose systematic residuals and the downweighted count. Add responsive HTML QA.

self_identified_weaknesses.issue: Rendered sensitivity headers were excessively wide, and narrative constants would be inaccurate for nondefault configurations.
self_identified_weaknesses.correction: Use concise unit-bearing Japanese headers and render actual valuation date, uncertainty floors, freshness limit and Huber threshold.

major_modelling_decisions: Construct deposit, OIS and bond cash flows using supplied continuous-discount conventions; explicitly assume ACT/365F prorated terminal stubs and analyze alternatives.
Audit all 143 observations; retain 131 instruments after seven duplicate and five stale exclusions; log all unit, midpoint, bid/ask and precision adjustments.

Use the same spread/liquidity-weighted Huber objective for a three-parameter fixed-tau Nelson-Siegel baseline and a natural cubic zero spline in log(1+T); retain ordinary least squares as an ablation.
Use analytic pricing Jacobians, up to eight IRLS warm starts and exact Huber-data/quadratic-curvature refinement; allow negative zero and forward rates with positive exponential discount factors.
Choose smoothing 0.001 by three-fold maturity-group validation inside the training set; select advanced only if outer holdout Huber loss improves by more than 5 percent.
Output 721 grid points through 30Y and receiver-fixed DV01 plus partition-of-unity 2Y/5Y/10Y/30Y key risks, checked by half-step finite differences.
unresolved_limitations: The supplied conventions do not uniquely specify off-cycle coupon/stub schedules; the chosen prorated treatment and alternative checks do not establish the generator convention.
Systematic OIS-tenor and long-bond pricing residuals remain. 80 of 131 usable observations receive reduced Huber weights, indicating possible model/convention misspecification as well as outliers.
Unit repairs use cross-sectional peers from the full visible tape before grouped validation; the holdout is not an untouched temporal or ground-truth test.
Long-end zero rates move by up to about 12 bp under the smoothing perturbations; one snapshot cannot establish temporal performance or statistical significance.
Spread-derived uncertainty, liquidity multipliers, unit inference, fixed knots, single-curve pricing and safety bounds are assumptions rather than verified market facts.
Risk is a direct zero-curve bump with fixed cash flows, not a quote-bump/recalibration hedge sensitivity. Credit and multi-curve effects are omitted.
